focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of screen text.
Anatomical correctness of the holding hand.
Boundary sharpness between hand and device.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' on the screen. While the device form factor is generally correct, the failure to render coherent text is a significant indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the keypad; AI often struggles with repetitive geometric patterns like keys, resulting in the 'melting' observed. Determine if these artifacts outweigh the correct general shape. Ensure the hand anatomy is verified via keypoint detection.
image_description: A close-up view of a human hand holding a black, rectangular handheld electronic device (PDA style). The device features a screen at the top displaying text and icons, and a physical keypad with various buttons below it. The image has a low-resolution, slightly grainy quality.
